card.name: Digits inside codes and numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 0, 1, 3, 5 or 9) placed in the middle of a longer code or number, such as a postcode, study ID, date, range or isotope name. The digit is followed by more characters that finish the code.

modes.label: Digit in an ID or postcode
modes.description: A digit inside a letter-digit code such as a postcode, study number or confidence interval.

modes.label: Digit in a number or date
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a measurement range, date or isotope number, where the number continues.

card.plain: It fires on a digit sitting in the middle of a longer code or number, like a postcode or study ID.
